📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-04
1. OpenAI's Next Model Astra Achieves 10 Mathematical Breakthroughs模型
OpenAI新模型Astra取得10項數學突破，橫跨密碼學與量子複雜度
OpenAI revealed that an internal version of its upcoming flagship model, Astra, has achieved 10 research breakthroughs across high-dimensional geometry, coding theory, group theory, quantum complexity, and lattice-based cryptography. Many of these problems had seen no progress for over a decade.
OpenAI上周六揭露，下一款主要模型Astra的內部版本，在數學及理論電腦科學領域取得10項研究成果，涵蓋高維幾何、編碼理論、群論、量子複雜度及格基密碼學，多數問題已停滯超過十年。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max Takes Another Swipe at America's AI Supremacy模型
阿里巴巴發布Qwen3.8-Max，挑戰美國AI領導地位
Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, which it calls its largest and most capable AI model to date, claiming performance rivaling top US labs like Anthropic and OpenAI as well as domestic rival Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.
中國科技巨頭阿里巴巴發布號稱旗下最大、最強的AI模型Qwen3.8-Max，宣稱效能可媲美Anthropic、OpenAI等美國頂尖實驗室，以及月之暗面Kimi K3等中國同業。
The Verge · 原文連結
3. Europe's AI Labeling and Transparency Rules Are Now in Effect政策
歐盟AI標示與透明化規範正式生效
New transparency obligations under the EU's AI Act took effect on August 2nd, requiring companies to disclose when people are interacting with chatbots or viewing AI-generated deepfakes.
歐盟AI法案新增的透明化義務已於8月2日生效，要求企業揭露使用者是否正在與聊天機器人互動，或觀看的內容是否為AI生成的深偽影像。
The Verge · 原文連結
4. Here's Why AI Agents Lie and Cheat to Reach Their Goals研究
解析AI代理為何會說謊與作弊以達成目標
After two OpenAI models hacked into Hugging Face last month without trying to make money or cause sabotage, researchers explain reward hacking — how AI agents exploit loopholes to satisfy their objectives.
上月兩個OpenAI模型入侵Hugging Face網站，並非為了謀利或蓄意破壞，研究人員藉此解析「獎勵駭客」現象，說明AI代理如何鑽漏洞以達成設定目標。
MIT Technology Review · 原文連結
5. Okta to Acquire Permiso, Strengthening Detection of AI Agent Identity Threats資安
Okta計畫併購Permiso，強化AI代理身分威脅的偵測
Identity and access management vendor Okta announced it signed an agreement to acquire cloud-native identity security firm Permiso Security, extending identity protection to activity by users, service accounts, machine identities, and AI agents.
身分暨存取管理業者Okta於7月30日宣布，已與雲端原生身分安全業者Permiso Security簽署收購協議，將身分安全防護延伸至使用者、服務帳號、機器身分及AI代理取得權限後的活動。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Keyfactor Secures Over $1 Billion Investment to Expand AI and PQC Security Business資安
Keyfactor獲逾10億美元投資，擴大AI與PQC安全業務
Machine identity and cryptographic asset management firm Keyfactor announced a strategic growth investment of over $1 billion led by Summit Partners, to fund product innovation, global expansion, and strategic acquisitions in AI and post-quantum cryptography security.
機器身分與密碼資產管理業者Keyfactor宣布，獲得由Summit Partners主導、金額逾10億美元的策略性成長投資，將用於產品創新、全球擴展及策略性併購，藉此擴大AI與後量子密碼學相關安全業務。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Taiwan Fiber Optic Firm TFC Hit by Ransomware Attack, Systems Gradually Recovering資安
聯合光纖遭勒索病毒攻擊，並表示資訊系統逐步恢復運作
Taiwanese fiber optic manufacturer Taiwan Fiber Communications disclosed that its information systems were hit by a ransomware attack; the company launched incident response measures and reported the case to police, with systems gradually returning to normal.
光通訊廠聯合光纖通信於8月3日公告資訊系統遭受勒索病毒攻擊，已展開內部資安檢查並向警方報案，目前系統陸續恢復正常運作，初步評估對營運無重大影響。
iThome · 原文連結
8. US Company's AI Lets Ukraine's Cheap Kamikaze Drones Track Targets on Their Own產業
美國公司AI技術讓烏克蘭廉價神風無人機自主追蹤目標
A $100 million deal is giving 50,000 Ukrainian kamikaze drones US-developed AI capabilities, enabling autonomous target tracking without constant operator input.
一筆價值1億美元的合約，讓烏克蘭5萬架廉價神風無人機獲得美國開發的AI能力，可自主追蹤目標，不必仰賴操作員持續操控。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
9. After Killer Quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp Calls AI Industry 'Marxist'產業
締造亮眼財報後，Palantir執行長卡普稱AI產業「馬克思主義」
After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises to rely on.
在繳出單季10億美元獲利的亮眼成績後，Palantir執行長Alex Karp再次警告，AI前沿實驗室對企業而言仍不夠可信賴。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. Starlink Reshapes Satellite Broadband Market as Veteran Hughes Files for Bankruptcy產業
Starlink改寫衛星寬頻市場，老牌業者Hughes聲請破產重整
Veteran US satellite communications provider Hughes announced that Hughes Satellite Systems and several US subsidiaries have filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization, planning to scale back consumer satellite broadband and pivot toward enterprise, government, and defense markets.
美國老牌衛星通訊業者Hughes宣布，Hughes Satellite Systems及部分美國子公司已聲請Chapter 11破產重整，計畫縮減消費者衛星寬頻業務，轉向企業、政府及國防市場。
